about_the_game: Buckle up for Mice to Mars, a thrilling blend of card-slinging strategy, tower defense, and roguelike chaos! Build an epic rocket to launch your fearless mice to the Red Planet, where every tile you play is a vital rocket part—engines, shields, or weapons—to outsmart relentless waves of cosmic debris and asteroids. Craft a killer deck to fortify your spacecraft and fend off threats in heart-pounding, ever-shifting battles across the stars. Each run delivers a galaxy-spanning adventure, brimming with strategic depth and unpredictable challenges that keep you hooked. Will your tiny explorers conquer the cosmos or crumble under pressure? Master your deck, assemble the ultimate rocket, and guide your mice to Martian glory in this addictive, out-of-this-world quest that’s bursting with replayable fun!
